ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a pair of similar house-shaped pentagons. The smaller blue pentagon on the left is labeled with area A = 153 in², and one of its slanted sides is labeled 15 in.; the larger green pentagon on the right is labeled with area A = 272 in², and the corresponding slanted side is labeled x in.. Reasoning: The area ratio of similar figures equals the square of the ratio of corresponding side lengths. Therefore the linear scale factor from the small figure to the large figure is sqrt(272/153). Calculate 272/153 = 16/9, so the linear scale factor is sqrt(16/9) = 4/3. The corresponding side length satisfies x = 15 × 4/3 = 20. Therefore x = 20.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as two similar house-shaped pentagons. The smaller figure has area 153 in^2 and a labeled side length 15 in.; the larger corresponding figure has area 272 in^2 and the corresponding side labeled x in. Since similar figures have area ratio equal to the square of the linear scale factor, compute the scale factor from small to large as sqrt(272/153). Simplify 272/153 = 16/9, so the scale factor is 4/3. Multiply the small corresponding side by this factor: x = 15 * 4/3 = 20.
